provenance.source_state: Uncommitted local implementation identified by content hashes; parent commit is not a publication of these changes.

baseline_snapshot.baselineDescription: Validated packed search index and owning metadata before model-scoped interning; uncommitted #75 snapshot

provenance.phase_note: The benchmark phase is frozen separately from the later final application build. Physics/frontend/CMake changes continued between phases. Core compact metadata, search, hierarchy and benchmark sources listed in stable_metadata_sources were asserted identical.
provenance.raw_artifacts: Ignored out/scene-browser-validation and out/scene-browser-interning-validation contain binaries, logs, XML, images and full telemetry.

methodology: Sequential fresh processes; no build, tests or renderer process ran during the 36 timed cases.
Same expanded benchmark source for both variants. Baseline links captured pre-interning headers/libraries: packed six-field search index and 592-byte owning metadata DTO.
Current uses complete 216-byte runtime metadata records with packed identity/name fields and model-scoped categorical IDs; no property entries in compact fixture.
CPU ImGui NewFrame/widgets/Render without platform or Vulkan backend. No geometry, full relationship graph, exact-GUID index, textures or GPU entity-scale claim.
Fixture setup, correctness interactions, index construction/installation, changed queries and 24 warmups excluded from steady timing.
Seven adaptive batched means; median is not an individual-frame percentile.
C++ and ImGui allocation hooks enabled only in a separate warmed allocation pass.
OS peak working set and OS process commit include construction, verification, unload/reload and timing. Sampled private commit can miss brief peaks.
Source/index capacities omit allocator bookkeeping. Process-memory savings are based on OS working set rather than sum of capacity estimates.
Closed/collapsed views mark row interaction inapplicable; filtered BIM verifies its final matching entity.
Cached frames do not rescan unchanged queries. These measurements do not establish faster cold loading or changed-query scans.

Pre-renderer-fix metadata identity uses synchronization validation, identical scene/camera/pass topology, all87 exact shader hashes and zero scene-only RGB differences. Final renderer captures allow explicitly recorded shader/ray-image differences after the separate raster-subpixel shadow bias correction; these are correctness checks, not matched timing comparisons.
